title: ci(temporal-conformance): give the non-SQL step the job's live PostgreSQL URL
body:
Fixes #21564
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

The `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` job's step "Run the non-SQL temporal backends under the skewed process zone" now sets `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` in its `env:`, with the same literal the job's three SQL steps use (`postgres://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/postgres`), for the postgres service the job already provisions. Until now that step set only `TZ`, so every `service-analytics` live-PostgreSQL cell (`describe.skipIf(!config)`) was a named skip there while the job read green.

The header clause "no CI step provisions that variable for this package" in 14 `service-analytics` test files becomes false with this wiring. It is corrected, comment-only, to name the step that now sets it. No other line of those files changes (every changed line in them is a ` * ` comment line).

No other job, no other step, and no timeout changes. No cell is re-skipped.

## What the step needed, measured (A2)

Only the one `env:` line:

- **Build closure.** `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/service-analytics... --dry=json` selects 16 packages, including `@objectstack/driver-sql`, `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/driver-sqlite-wasm` (dev dependencies of `service-analytics`). The step's existing build already builds what the cells import.
- **PostgreSQL client.** `pg` is an optional peer of `driver-sql`, resolved by pnpm into `driver-sql`'s `knex` instance (`knex@3.3.0_..._pg@8.22.0`); `require.resolve('pg')` from that `knex` answers `pg@8.22.0`. The cells reach `pg` through `SqlDriver`, so nothing is added to `service-analytics`.
- **Database and tables.** Every cell connects to the default `postgres` database and creates and drops its own tables. The table names are distinct across the 16 files (`os21316_deal`, `os21505_coercion`, ...), so parallel vitest workers do not collide.
- **Server zone.** The job's existing step "Point both servers at a non-UTC timezone" sets the server to `Asia/Shanghai` before any test step.

## Readings

- **A3.** No `service-analytics` file reads `OS_EXPECT_LIVE_DIALECT_MATRIX` (`git grep` exit 1), and no code in the step's other four packages reads it (the only hit, in `driver-mongodb/src/test-mongod.ts`, is a comment). So the flag is not added to the step, and no code reading it is added.
- **A4.** No `service-analytics` file reads `OS_TEST_MYSQL_URL` or any other server variable the job provides. Its only `process.env` reads are `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` (32), `NODE_ENV` and `TZ`. Nothing is listed for MySQL.
- **A5.** `core`, `formula`, `driver-memory` and `driver-mongodb` have zero `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` hits (`git grep` exit 1 for each). Adding the variable to the step starts no test in them.

## Local run against a non-UTC PostgreSQL 16

PostgreSQL 16.14 started privately on a random port with `timezone=Asia/Shanghai`, process `TZ=America/New_York` (the job's two zones), `service-analytics` full suite, tree `3f9dcd91c4`. Counts are passed / failed / skipped per file, from vitest's JSON reporter.

| file | without the URL | with the URL |
|:--|:--|:--|
| analytics-faces-one-lowering | 69 / 0 / 20 | 88 / 0 / 1 |
| cube-measure-field-type-door | 12 / 0 / 11 | 23 / 0 / 0 |
| cube-measure-relationship-path-type | 7 / 0 / 6 | 13 / 0 / 0 |
| json-stored-door-live-drivers | 5 / 0 / 5 | 10 / 0 / 0 |
| json-stored-door-undeclared-join | 5 / 0 / 5 | 10 / 0 / 0 |
| list-at-scalar-operator-both-faces | 43 / 0 / 43 | 86 / 0 / 0 |
| native-sql-aggregate-policies | 25 / 0 / 24 | 49 / 0 / 0 |
| native-sql-base-column-qualify | 6 / 0 / 6 | 12 / 0 / 0 |
| native-sql-boolean-comparand-door | 34 / 0 / 34 | 68 / 0 / 0 |
| native-sql-measure-number-presentation | 5 / 0 / 5 | 10 / 0 / 0 |
| native-sql-number-comparand-door | 58 / 0 / 58 | 116 / 0 / 0 |
| native-sql-offset-only-window | 8 / 0 / 6 | 14 / 0 / 0 |
| objectql-echo-offset-only-window | 3 / 0 / 3 | 6 / 0 / 0 |
| **objectql-face-order-limit** | 13 / 0 / 13 | **22 / 4 / 0** |
| order-key-selected | 8 / 0 / 8 | 16 / 0 / 0 |
| read-scope-temporal-coercion | 10 / 0 / 6 | 15 / 0 / 1 |
| **16 files** | 311 / 0 / 253 | 558 / 4 / 2 |

Whole package: 4152 passed, 253 skipped without the URL; 4399 passed, 4 failed, 2 skipped with it. The two skips left are cell-scoped by design: the SQLite cell's "the server is not on UTC" check in `read-scope-temporal-coercion`, and the PostgreSQL cell's SQLite-only "a host with no typed reader" case in `analytics-faces-one-lowering`.

## One live cell is red once wired

`objectql-face-order-limit.test.ts`, the `live postgres` cell, 4 tests:

| test | assertion | expected | received |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| the card's row: ordered desc and limited to 1 | `:244` (native face) | `[['2026-06', 1]]` | `[['2026-05', 2]]` |
| ordered desc with offset 1 and limit 2 | `:257` | `[['2026-05', 20], ['2026-04', 1]]` | `[['2026-03', 6], ['2026-02', 10]]` |
| CONTROL with no order, offset or limit, bucketed time dimension | `:334` | 4 buckets | 3 |
| the dataset door, month-bucketed, desc, offset 1, limit 2 | `:363` (native face) | `[['2026-05', 20], ['2026-04', 1]]` | `[['2026-03', 6], ['2026-02', 10]]` |

Every `closed_on` (a `date` field) lands one day early: `03-01` becomes Feb, `06-01` joins May.

- **The axis is the server zone, not the process zone.** The same file with the session pinned to UTC (`options=-c TimeZone=UTC` on the URL) and `TZ=America/New_York`: 26 passed. With the server on `Asia/Shanghai` and `TZ=UTC`: the same 4 failed.
- **Where it comes from (a reading, not a fix).** `driver-sql`'s `buildDateBucketExpr` PostgreSQL branch (`sql-driver.ts:6134-6138`) buckets with `to_char((col)::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM')`. On a `date` column, `::timestamptz` resolves midnight in the session zone. In `psql` on the same server, `to_char(('2026-06-01'::date)::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD')` answers `2026-05-31` under `Asia/Shanghai` and `2026-06-01` under UTC.

Per the triage ruling, this is a real red. It is ⛔ not fixed here and ⛔ not re-skipped. The PM cards it to the cell's lane. Until then this PR's `Temporal Conformance` check is expected to be red, and the PR stays a draft.

**Acceptance is read from this PR's own `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` job log (cells run, not skipped), not from green.** That reading, against a recent `main` run of the same step, is recorded in the os-dev report on the card.

## Acceptance notes

- The ruling says each of these cells "asserts a non-UTC server". At this tree, 1 of the 16 files does (`read-scope-temporal-coercion.test.ts:233-237`, `show timezone`). The other 15 rely on the job's provisioning step for the server's zone. The red cell above is zone-sensitive and asserts no server zone. Noted, not changed.
- **Stall guard.** `check:stall-guard-budget` reads this step's static budget as window 10m, cap 20m, job budget 30m, slack 10m (2 of 2 guarded steps share the clock). The step's measured time on this PR is in the card report.
- **Release.** Nothing publishes: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, and comments in test files outside `service-analytics`'s `files[]` (`dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`). Measured after a build: `os21316_deal`, `no CI step` and the new step name have 0 hits in those files; positive control `AnalyticsServicePlugin` has 4. No changeset; `skip-changeset`.
- **Governed.** `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch`: 0 of 15 paths hit the register, NOT governed; 110 changed lines.

## Gates

Run on head `a3fb6c0334` (the merge of `origin/main` `a3873542ca`). Each exit code was recorded before any pipe.

- 85 of the 87 commands `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives exited 0. This includes `check:required-contexts`, `check-ci-filter-parity` and its `--self-test`, `check:workflow-step-name-quoting`, `check:workflow-status-functions`, `check:stall-guard-budget`, `check:stall-guard-headroom`, `check:pnpm-filter-targets`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests` and `check-changeset-no-major`.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`. It needs a full `pnpm build`, and this diff changes no package's built output. NOT MEASURED; CI runs it.
- `check:pm-dispatch-gates` and `check:type-check-debt`: each ran past the local 420 s bound (exit 124) on the shared box, then were re-run without that bound. That result is in the card report.
- `service-analytics`: `typecheck` passed; its full test suite is in the table above.
